900001:319.characters: A loading mask disables all interactions, much like blocking global loading, and offers less flexibility than local loading or loading that allows navigation. It can be considered when delivery time and development resources are extremely limited and a single global loading mechanism is needed.

900001:328.name: 成功、失败、操作反馈告知等短时效提示建议采用轻提示组件，相对轻量化干扰性若
900001:328.characters: Use a toast for short-lived success, failure or action feedback. It provides lightweight feedback with little interruption.

900001:333.name: 使用气泡组件拓展能力实现友好提示
900001:333.characters: Use popover options to provide helpful guidance.

900001:334.name: 在涉及复杂操作或相对隐藏功能的场景我们可以通过气泡组件的变量支持实现轻量化友好提示，遗憾的是现在气泡组件仅提供亮色、暗黑两种颜色模式，暂不支持自定义，会在后期优化；
900001:334.characters: For complex actions or less discoverable features, popover options can provide lightweight guidance. The component currently supports light and dark themes; custom colors are not yet available and may be added later.

900001:344.name: 这是一段友好提示文本

900001:347.name: 支持自定义色彩的友好提示（组件变量未支持可通过代码调整）
900001:347.characters: Guidance with custom colors. This is not yet a component option; implement it in code if needed.

900001:354.name: 这是一段友好提示文本

900001:359.name: 请求时间超过500ms尽量采用全局加载动画
900001:359.characters: For requests taking over 500 ms, consider a global loading animation.

900001:360.name: 涉及较大数据量请求的页面和面板都可以采用全局加载样式，如非特殊需求建议采用组件默认尺寸；
900001:360.characters: Pages and panels that request large amounts of data can use global loading. Use the default component size unless the scenario requires otherwise.
